datos.Opresión aguda en pecho, síncope, arritm: Acute chest tightness, syncope, arrhythmia or cardiorespiratory arrest in microgravity.
datos.DEA y parches: Rack Médico B2 · Camilla: AED and pads: Medical Rack B2 · CMRS stretcher: Node 2 · ALSP kit: Red Bag
datos.Descarta fuga tóxica o hipoxia ambiental: Rule out a toxic leak or environmental hypoxia (check cabin O₂/CO₂). Assess consciousness and breathing in under 10 seconds.
datos.Ancla primero tus propios pies a los rie: Anchor your own feet to the floor rails before handling your crewmate.
datos.Fija al paciente antes de iniciar las co: Restrain the patient before starting compressions
datos.Sin sujeción a la camilla CMRS o apoyo d: Without CMRS stretcher straps or feet braced on the opposite wall (Handstand stance), the compression force pushes the rescuer away by Newton's third law.
datos.Si estás solo y aún no hay correas CMRS,: If you are alone and the CMRS straps are not yet in place, use the Handstand method (feet on the upper wall, hands on the sternum) at 110 compressions/min and 5–6 cm deep.
datos.Colocación del DEA y aislamiento eléctri: AED placement and electrical isolation in 0G
datos.Adhiere los parches del DEA (Rack B2) so: Apply the AED pads (Rack B2) on a dry chest. Before pressing shock, make sure no crewmate is floating in contact with the patient or the metal structure.
datos.El sudor en 0G no escurre: forma una pel: Sweat does not run off in 0G: it forms a conductive film over the chest. Dry it completely with gauze before applying pads.
datos.Mantén relación 30:2. Conecta máscara de: Keep the 30:2 ratio. Connect the portable oxygen mask (PBA) and record vital signs every 2 minutes.
datos.Evita hiperventilación; asegura el sella: Avoid hyperventilation; secure the face seal with the elastic strap.
datos.Empaquetado SBAR para el Flight Surgeon: SBAR package for the Flight Surgeon
datos.Transmite la bitácora automática con mar: Send the automatic log with UTC timestamps, completed cycles and the latest baseline biochemistry (OSD-575) as soon as the link window opens.
datos.El paquete queda almacenado en IndexedDB: The package is stored in local storage even if console power is lost.
datos.Disnea aguda, SpO₂ menor a 90%, confusió: Acute dyspnoea, SpO₂ below 90%, confusion or headache from local CO₂ accumulation.
datos.Máscara PBA O₂ 100%: Mamparo frontal · A: 100% O₂ PBA mask: forward bulkhead · Portable CO₂ analyzer: Environmental Rack
datos.Coloca máscara de O₂ portátil (PBA) de i: Put on the portable O₂ mask (PBA) immediately
datos.Aísla la vía aérea del aire de cabina an: Isolate the airway from cabin air before looking for the cause of the environmental failure.
datos.En 0G no existe convección natural: se f: There is no natural convection in 0G: stagnant CO₂ pockets form around the head if ventilation fails.
datos.Traslado a módulo con ventilación forzad: Move to a module with forced ventilation
datos.Desplaza al tripulante hacia el ducto de: Move the crew member to the active laminar-flow duct and measure SpO₂ and respiratory rate.
datos.Verifica que el pulsoxímetro tenga buen: Check that the pulse oximeter has good capillary contact.
datos.Contrasta con el analito carbon_dioxide: Compare with the carbon_dioxide analyte in your personal OSD-575 baseline (range 20–32 mmol/L).
datos.Guarda el evento en la cola diferida par: Queue the event for medical review on Earth.
datos.Alteración visual súbita o vértigo sever: Sudden visual disturbance or severe vertigo
datos.Escotoma central, diplopía, cefalea intr: Central scotoma, diplopia, severe intracranial headache or acute spatial disorientation.
datos.Rejilla Amsler y oftalmoscopio: Gaveta M: Amsler grid and ophthalmoscope: Medical Drawer M1 · Soft restraint: Hab Node
datos.Sujeta al tripulante a un punto fijo par: Hold the crew member against a fixed point to stop the vestibular-visual conflict in microgravity.
datos.Prueba rápida de agudeza y rejilla de Am: Quick acuity test and Amsler grid
datos.Evalúa ojo por ojo a 30 cm de distancia: Assess each eye at 30 cm and record any distortion of central lines or blind spot.
datos.Compara contra la línea base pre-vuelo r: Compare against the recorded pre-flight baseline.
datos.Realiza toma capilar de glucosa y electr: Take a capillary glucose and electrolyte sample (sodium/potassium) and package the results for the Flight Surgeon.
datos.En OSD-575 se documentaron glucosas de 3: OSD-575 documents glucose values of 36 and 44 mg/dL; always rule out a metabolic cause.
datos.Control de sangrado en 0G, fijación en c: Bleeding control in 0G, CMRS stretcher restraint and monitoring for rhabdomyolysis or dehydration.
datos.Kit de Trauma y vendaje compresivo: Bols: Trauma kit and compression bandage: Red Bag · CMRS stretcher: Node 2
datos.Aplica gasa hemostática y vendaje elásti: Apply haemostatic gauze and an elastic compression bandage while keeping your feet anchored to the rail.
datos.La sangre venosa en 0G forma domos adher: Venous blood forms clinging domes in 0G; use suction or absorbent gauze to avoid floating droplets in the cabin.
datos.Asegura las correas pélvica y torácica y: Secure the pelvic and thoracic straps and check heart rate and blood pressure every 5 minutes.
datos.La pérdida de volumen intravascular se t: Intravascular volume loss is tolerated worse after adaptation to microgravity.
datos.Registra los analitos del panel OSD-575: Record the OSD-575 panel analytes and package the log for Earth.
datos.Analizador Clínico Portátil (Cartucho CG: Portable Clinical Analyzer (CG8+ cartridge / capillary puncture)
datos.Fija tu antebrazo al riel Velcro del mód: Strap your forearm to the medical module's Velcro rail. Clean the tip of your ring finger with sterile gauze and wait 10 seconds for the alcohol to evaporate completely.
datos.Acerca el cartucho a 90° de la esfera de: Bring the cartridge to 90° to the blood dome
datos.En microgravedad la gota no cae: forma u: In microgravity the drop does not fall: surface tension holds it as a dome on the finger. Touch the edge of the dome with the cartridge's capillary channel without shaking your hand.
datos.Lectura y contraste contra tu línea base: Reading and comparison with your baseline
datos.Inserta el cartucho en el lector portáti: Insert the cartridge into the portable reader, record the numeric value and compare it automatically with your pre-flight mean (L-92, L-44, L-3).
datos.Evita burbujas en el canal capilar: Avoid bubbles in the capillary channel
datos.Si entra aire al canal capilar por acerc: If air enters the capillary channel because the strip is approached at an oblique angle in 0G, the analyzer reports a falsely low reading (<60 mg/dL) or a fill error code.
datos.Verifica que el cartucho haya permanecid: Check that the cartridge has been at cabin temperature (18–30 °C) for 5 minutes before opening the package.
datos.Absorbe la esfera capilar hasta la marca: Absorb the capillary dome up to the fill mark by surface tension.
datos.Registra el valor en mg/dL para vigilar: Record the value in mg/dL to watch for hypercalcaemia linked to bone demineralisation in microgravity.
datos.No presiones el centro del cartucho al c: Do not press the centre of the cartridge when closing the lid; in 0G displaced calibrator fluid invalidates the internal control.
datos.Registra si hubo actividad extravehicula: Record any extravehicular activity (EVA) or fluid restriction in the last 6 hours.
datos.Extrae la muestra por acción capilar a 9: Draw the sample by capillary action at 90°, avoiding haemolysis from squeezing the fingertip.
datos.Ingresa el resultado en mg/dL para compa: Enter the result in mg/dL to compare against your pre-flight mean in OSD-575.
datos.La redistribución cefálica de fluidos y: Cephalic fluid shift and 0G-induced diuresis can transiently raise creatinine and BUN.
datos.Uso de las cuatro herramientas críticas: Using the four critical Red Bag tools, step by step
datos.Bolsa Roja · Rack Médico B2 · Camilla CM: Red Bag · Medical Rack B2 · CMRS stretcher in Node 2
datos.AHA 2020 ACLS · ISS Medical Checklist (J: AHA 2020 ACLS · ISS Medical Checklist (JSC-48522) · AEB 2026 brief
datos.Material de entrenamiento y demostración: Training and demonstration material. Not a medical device: it does not diagnose, prescribe or replace the Flight Surgeon's judgement or certified training.
datos.Analiza el ritmo y administra una descar: Analyses the rhythm and delivers a shock to stop ventricular fibrillation or pulseless tachycardia.
datos.Paro cardiorrespiratorio presenciado, in: Witnessed cardiorespiratory arrest, unresponsive and not breathing normally.
datos.Unidad sellada con protección EMI y cont: Sealed unit with EMI and cosmic-radiation protection, no spark risk in the cabin. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.Verifica O₂ y CO₂ de cabina, sacude los: Check cabin O₂ and CO₂, shake the shoulders and watch for normal breathing for no more than 10 seconds.
datos.Ancla primero tus pies en los rieles del: Anchor your feet on the floor rails first: without a fixed point any push moves you away and takes the patient off the stretcher.
datos.No entres si hay alarma de fuga tóxica o: Do not enter if there is a toxic-leak or environmental-hypoxia alarm.
datos.Seca el tórax y adhiere los dos parches: Dry the chest and apply both pads
datos.Seca la piel con gasa. Coloca el parche: Dry the skin with gauze. Place the right pad under the right clavicle and the left pad on the mid-axillary line at the 5th intercostal space. Press the gel against the skin.
datos.En 0G el sudor no escurre: forma una pel: In 0G sweat does not run off: it forms a conductive film over the chest. If not dried, the shock spreads and can burn the skin.
datos.No coloques parches sobre el esternón, u: Do not place pads over the sternum, a visible pacemaker or medicated dressings.
datos.Conecta el cable y deja que analice: Connect the cable and let it analyse
datos.Conecta el conector de parches al DEA, e: Connect the pad connector to the AED, switch the unit on and touch no one during analysis. The AED says whether the rhythm is shockable.
datos.Nadie debe estar en contacto con el paci: Nobody may be in contact with the patient or the metal structure: current finds any path, including a floating body.
datos.Durante el análisis, manos fuera del pac: During analysis, hands off the patient and the stretcher.
datos.Despeja la escena y administra la descar: Clear the scene and deliver the shock
datos.Anuncia en voz alta «apártense», confirm: Call “clear” out loud, visually confirm nobody is touching the patient, stretcher or straps, and press the shock button when the AED says so.
datos.Comprueba también que no haya oxígeno li: Also make sure there is no free oxygen near the chest: a spark in an enriched atmosphere is a fire risk.
datos.Descarga solo cuando el DEA lo ordene. N: Shock only when the AED orders it. Nobody in contact with the patient.
datos.Retoma compresiones a 100–120 por minuto: Resume compressions at 100–120 per minute, 5–6 cm deep, with full recoil. Ventilate twice every 30 compressions and rotate the compressor every 2 minutes.
datos.Si estás solo y no hay correas CMRS, usa: If you are alone and there are no CMRS straps, use the Handstand method: feet on the upper wall, hands on the sternum, using the wall as your fixed point.
datos.No interrumpas las compresiones más de 1: Do not interrupt compressions for more than 10 seconds.
datos.AHA 2020 Guidelines for CPR and ECC — ri: AHA 2020 Guidelines for CPR and ECC — shockable rhythm, high-quality CPR and AED.
datos.ISS Medical Checklist (JSC-48522) — resp: ISS Medical Checklist (JSC-48522) — cardiovascular response in microgravity.
datos.Infunde cristaloides y fármacos por vía: Infuses crystalloids and drugs intravenously when gravity provides no hydrostatic pressure.
datos.Hipotensión, pérdida de volumen, necesid: Hypotension, volume loss, need for a patent IV line for resuscitation drugs.
datos.Bolsa de 500 mL dentro de manguito de pr: 500 mL bag inside a pressure cuff, inflation bulb, manometer, line with air filter and 18 G catheter. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.Arma el sistema y purga todo el aire: Assemble the system and purge all air
datos.Introduce el equipo de infusión en la bo: Insert the infusion set into the bag, fill half the drip chamber and purge the line until no bubbles remain. Close the clamp before connecting to the patient.
datos.En 0G las burbujas no suben: invierte el: In 0G bubbles do not rise: invert the drip chamber, tap the barrel and purge outwards. A trapped bubble can travel to the heart.
datos.Nunca conectes una línea con aire. Usa e: Never connect a line with air in it. Use the in-line filter.
datos.Coloca la bolsa dentro del manguito, cié: Put the bag inside the cuff, close it and pump the bulb until the manometer reads the indicated infusion pressure. Check that the drip chamber drips.
datos.Sin columna de gravedad no hay flujo: la: With no gravity column there is no flow: cuff pressure replaces the 90 cm height of a terrestrial drip.
datos.No excedas la presión máxima indicada po: Do not exceed the bag manufacturer's maximum pressure.
datos.Canaliza la vena con técnica estéril: Cannulate the vein with sterile technique
datos.Coloca el torniquete, desinfecta y punci: Apply the tourniquet, disinfect and puncture the antecubital vein with the bevel up at 15–30°. Wait for flashback, advance the catheter and withdraw the needle.
datos.Fija el brazo contra el soporte antes de: Strap the arm to the support before puncturing: any body drift moves the needle inside the vein. Drop the needle in the sharps container.
datos.Si no hay reflujo, no avances a ciegas:: If there is no flashback, do not advance blindly: withdraw and reassess.
datos.Conecta, fija y regula el goteo: Connect, secure and set the drip rate
datos.Conecta la línea al catéter, abre la pin: Connect the line to the catheter, open the clamp and set the drip. Secure the catheter with a transparent sterile dressing and tape, without tensioning the line.
datos.Deja una lazada de holgura: si la línea: Leave a slack loop: if the line is taut, a floating movement pulls the catheter out. Check there is no air in the final segment.
datos.La línea debe quedar fija al soporte, no: The line must be fixed to the support, not to the patient's body.
datos.Vigila sitio, volumen y respuesta: Monitor the site, volume and response
datos.Revisa el sitio cada 5 minutos: dolor, e: Check the site every 5 minutes: pain, oedema, pallor or resistance to flow mean stop the infusion. Record infused volume and vital signs.
datos.En 0G el líquido extravasado se acumula: In 0G extravasated fluid collects and spreads through fascial planes without forming an immediately visible pocket.
datos.Detén la infusión ante dolor, edema o fa: Stop the infusion on pain, oedema or lack of return.
datos.AHA 2020 ACLS — acceso vascular y fluido: AHA 2020 ACLS — vascular access and fluids in resuscitation.
datos.ISS Medical Checklist (JSC-48522) — admi: ISS Medical Checklist (JSC-48522) — fluid administration in microgravity.
datos.Práctica estándar de terapia intravenosa: Standard intravenous therapy practice; dose and pressure [TO BE VALIDATED].
datos.Abre la vía aérea, ventila con bolsa-vál: Open the airway, ventilate with a bag-valve-mask and secure the trachea with an endotracheal tube.
datos.Apnea, obstrucción de la vía aérea, hipo: Apnoea, airway obstruction, refractory hypoxia or need for assisted ventilation.
datos.Bolsa-válvula-mascarilla con reservorio,: Bag-valve-mask with reservoir, portable O₂ cylinder, laryngoscope, 7.5 endotracheal tube, 10 mL syringe, suction unit and capnograph. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.Alinea la cabeza, tracciona la mandíbula: Align the head, pull the jaw and suction
datos.Con la cabeza en posición neutra, tracci: With the head neutral, pull the jaw up and forward. Suction secretions and assess the reflex. Size the oropharyngeal airway from the mouth corner to the jaw angle.
datos.La lengua no cae por gravedad y los líqu: The tongue does not fall with gravity and fluids float: jaw thrust and trapped suction are mandatory before ventilating.
datos.No hiperextiendas el cuello si sospechas: Do not hyperextend the neck if you suspect a cervical injury.
datos.Sella la mascarilla y ventila con bolsa: Seal the mask and ventilate with the bag
datos.Sella boca y nariz con la mascarilla, su: Seal mouth and nose with the mask, hold it with both hands and connect O₂ at 15 L/min. Deliver 500–600 mL in 1 second until chest rise, at 10 breaths per minute.
datos.Asegura la mascarilla con la correa elás: Secure the mask with the elastic strap: a floating hand cannot keep the face seal during the whole transfer.
datos.Si el tórax no se eleva, reevalúa el sel: If the chest does not rise, reassess the seal and patency before persisting.
datos.Preoxigena y prepara el equipo de intuba: Preoxygenate and prepare the intubation kit
datos.Preoxigena con O₂ al 100%, prueba el bal: Preoxygenate with 100% O₂, test the tube cuff, lubricate the tip, insert the stylet without protruding and check the laryngoscope light and suction.
datos.Fija cada instrumento con una cinta ante: Tape each instrument before opening it: a tube or laryngoscope released in 0G becomes a dangerous floating object.
datos.Estilete nunca más allá de la punta del: Stylet never beyond the tube tip.
datos.Introduce la hoja del laringoscopio y el: Insert the laryngoscope blade and lift tongue and epiglottis without levering. Visualise the vocal cords, pass the tube and withdraw it from the stylet once past the cords.
datos.Un ayudante debe inmovilizar la cabeza y: An assistant must hold the head and stretcher: laryngoscope force moves the whole patient in microgravity.
datos.No fuerces el tubo: si no ves cuerdas, v: Do not force the tube: if you cannot see the cords, ventilate with the mask and try again.
datos.Infla el balón y confirma la posición: Inflate the cuff and confirm position
datos.Infla el balón con 5–10 mL de aire, cone: Inflate the cuff with 5–10 mL of air, connect the bag and confirm with sustained capnography, bilateral auscultation and no epigastric sounds. Secure the tube at 21–23 cm at the incisor.
datos.La capnografía es la confirmación defini: Capnography is the definitive confirmation: the cabin has no portable X-ray and no reliable auscultation over fan noise.
datos.Sin onda de capnografía sostenida, asume: Without a sustained capnography waveform, assume an oesophageal or displaced tube.
datos.Fija, vigila y prepara el plan de rescat: Secure, monitor and prepare the rescue plan
datos.Fija el tubo con cinta, marca la profund: Tape the tube, mark the depth, monitor EtCO₂, SpO₂ and cuff pressure. Keep suction and rescue kit at hand for emergency extubation.
datos.Revisa la fijación cada traslado: las co: Check the fixation on every transfer: straps and tube shift with module changes and restraint manoeuvres.

datos.Administra fármacos precargados para par: Administer preloaded drugs for cardiac arrest, bradycardia, arrhythmias and severe pain.
datos.Paro cardiaco, anafilaxia, bradicardia s: Cardiac arrest, anaphylaxis, symptomatic bradycardia, ventricular arrhythmia or analgesia in trauma.
datos.Jeringas precargadas de epinefrina, atro: Preloaded syringes of epinephrine, atropine, lidocaine and strong analgesia, sterile needles, swabs and sharps container. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.Abre la Bolsa Roja, lee en voz alta el n: Open the Red Bag, read the name, concentration and expiry date aloud. Confirm the indication and route before preparing the syringe.
datos.Mantén las jeringas sujetas con una cint: Keep syringes taped down or in the magnetic tray: caps and covers float away and get lost.
datos.Nunca administres un fármaco sin leer la: Never give a drug without reading the label aloud.
datos.Con la aguja hacia arriba, golpea el bar: With the needle up, tap the barrel and push the plunger until a drop appears at the tip. Adjust the final volume before administering.
datos.Las burbujas no suben solas: golpea e in: Bubbles do not rise by themselves: tap and invert the syringe until they gather at the tip.
datos.Nunca inyectes una burbuja visible por v: Never inject a visible bubble intravenously.
datos.En paro cardiaco utiliza la vía IV/IO pe: In cardiac arrest use the patent IV/IO line. In anaphylaxis without venous access, give epinephrine intramuscularly into the vastus lateralis.
datos.La absorción intramuscular puede ser más: Intramuscular absorption may be slower in microgravity; if a patent IV line exists, prefer it. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.Confirma la vía antes de administrar: la: Confirm the line before giving: vasopressor extravasation causes necrosis.
datos.Desinfecta el puerto, conecta y administ: Disinfect the port, connect and give the indicated dose. In cardiac arrest push the epinephrine and follow with a 20 mL saline bolus.
datos.Fija la jeringa a la línea antes de empu: Secure the syringe to the line before pushing: the recoil displaces you and can disconnect the port.
datos.Dosis de referencia: epinefrina 1 mg IV/: Reference dose: epinephrine 1 mg IV/IO every 3–5 min in arrest. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.Registra, programa la siguiente dosis y: Record, schedule the next dose and monitor
datos.Anota fármaco, dosis, vía y hora UTC. Pr: Note drug, dose, route and UTC time. Schedule the next interval, watch rhythm and response, and drop the needle in the sharps container.
datos.La bitácora local sobrevive a los cortes: The local log survives link outages: the Flight Surgeon receives the package when the comms window returns.
datos.Nunca reencapuchones la aguja: deposítal: Never recap the needle: drop it straight in.
datos.Vía IV/IO. Dosis de referencia ACLS. [PO: IV/IO route. ACLS reference dose. [TO BE VALIDATED]
datos.repetir a los 5–15 min si persiste: repeat in 5–15 min if it persists

Alternative in ventricular arrhythmias. [TO BE VALIDATED]

cadenas.Sin datos para calibrar; evalúa contra r: No baseline to calibrate; evaluate against reference range and check sensor.
cadenas.Lectura en zona de vigilancia; reevalúa: Reading in watch zone; re-evaluate per station protocol.
cadenas.Parámetro crítico; activar respuesta pri: Critical parameter; activate priority response and notify CMO.
cadenas.Descansa unos minutos anclado en reposo,: Rest for a few minutes anchored in stillness, breathe slowly and deeply, hydrate, and repeat the reading to confirm whether it returns toward your baseline.
cadenas.Siéntate o ánclate en calma, verifica el: Sit or anchor calmly, check sensor or strap contact, and repeat the measurement at rest before physical exertion.
cadenas.Descansa unos minutos en calma, hidrátat: Rest quietly for a few minutes, hydrate, and repeat the heart rate reading at rest.
cadenas.Permanece en reposo sentado unos minutos: Remain calmly seated for a few minutes, practice paced breathing, avoid immediate exertion, and repeat the reading with the cuff at heart level.
cadenas.Ancla el cuerpo en posición estable, hid: Anchor your body in a stable position, hydrate gradually, avoid sudden movements, and repeat the measurement with the cuff properly fitted.
cadenas.Permanece en calma unos minutos, hidráta: Stay calm for a few minutes, hydrate, and repeat the reading with the cuff at heart level.
cadenas.Descansa en quietud con respiración lent: Rest quietly with slow, steady breathing, temporarily avoid physical exertion, and repeat the reading with the cuff at heart level.
cadenas.Ancla tu postura con estabilidad, hidrát: Anchor your posture steadily, hydrate progressively, avoid sudden movements, and repeat the measurement.
cadenas.Reposa unos minutos en calma, cuida tu h: Rest quietly for a few minutes, maintain hydration, and repeat the reading with the cuff properly positioned.
cadenas.Toma respiraciones lentas y profundas, c: Take slow, deep breaths, warm your fingers and readjust the pulse oximeter without over-tightening, check module ventilation, and repeat at rest.
cadenas.Haz una pausa en reposo con respiracione: Pause at rest with slow, regular breaths, check module ventilation, and re-measure after a few calm minutes.
cadenas.Ponte cómodo en una zona bien ventilada,: Get comfortable in a well-ventilated area, stay awake and calm, and repeat the measurement to confirm your breathing pattern.
cadenas.Haz una pausa en reposo, respira de form: Pause at rest, breathe slowly and steadily, check air circulation, and repeat the measurement.
cadenas.Trasládate temporalmente a un módulo con: Move temporarily to a module with better airflow, check cabin fans and CO2 scrubbers, rest quietly, and monitor whether discomfort subsides.
cadenas.Descansa en un módulo bien ventilado, cu: Rest in a well-ventilated module, maintain hydration, check cabin airflow, and repeat the discrete analysis at rest.
cadenas.Hidrátate de forma regular según tu paut: Hydrate steadily according to your mission schedule, rest briefly, and repeat a clean 0G capillary sample.
cadenas.Prioriza descanso, hidratación progresiv: Prioritize rest, steady hydration, and good module ventilation; repeat the discrete panel to confirm stabilization.
cadenas.Repite primero la prueba capilar en cero: First repeat the 0G capillary test at 90 degrees making sure there are no air bubbles in the strip; if confirmed, eat from your scheduled ration and re-measure.
cadenas.Hidrátate con agua, descansa brevemente,: Drink water, rest briefly, confirm the 0G capillary reading with a clean fingertip, and log your last meal intake.
cadenas.Confirma la lectura capilar en cero grav: Confirm the 0G capillary reading at 90 degrees without air bubbles and correlate it with your last scheduled meal.
cadenas.Refuerza tu hidratación con líquidos pro: Increase scheduled fluid intake, check the visual urine hydration chart and recent exercise or EVA workload, and repeat the reading.
cadenas.Aumenta la ingesta hídrica programada, d: Increase scheduled water intake, rest after intense activity, and re-measure to verify hydration and recovery.
cadenas.Cuida la hidratación gradual con agua, m: Maintain gradual water hydration, temporarily moderate strenuous exertion, and repeat the discrete panel.
cadenas.Equilibra tu hidratación y ración de ele: Balance hydration and electrolyte rations per mission plan, rest briefly, and repeat a clean capillary reading.
cadenas.Cuida la hidratación con electrolitos co: Maintain electrolyte hydration per your nutrition plan, avoid intense exertion while watching your heart rate, and repeat the strip without air bubbles.
cadenas.Mantén al día tus rutinas programadas de: Keep up your scheduled resistive exercise and mission nutrition countermeasures, hydrate well, and repeat the capillary sample at rest.
cadenas.Sostén tus contramedidas de ejercicio de: Maintain onboard resistive and aerobic exercise countermeasures, keep up hydration and rest, and follow up on your next check.
cadenas.Prioriza reposo, hidratación y alimentac: Prioritize rest, hydration, and regular meals; temporarily ease intense physical workload and repeat the discrete panel.
cadenas.Prioriza reposo, buena hidratación y nut: Prioritize rest, good hydration, and balanced nutrition; temporarily avoid physical overload and repeat the discrete analysis.
cadenas.Cuida tu descanso e hidratación, evita a: Look after your rest and hydration, avoid prolonged fasting or strenuous exertion, and repeat the sample under stable conditions.
cadenas.Mantén hidratación y aporte nutricional: Maintain adequate hydration and nutrition along with regular rest, and repeat the reading to confirm stability.
cadenas.Refuerza tu hidratación y nutrición prog: Reinforce scheduled hydration and nutrition and repeat the sample at rest to rule out mild microgravity hemoconcentration.
cadenas.Prioriza descanso suficiente, higiene en: Prioritize adequate rest, cabin hygiene, and steady hydration; log any mild symptoms and follow up.
cadenas.Cuida tu descanso, nutrición equilibrada: Look after your rest, balanced nutrition, and progressive hydration, and follow up on the next reading.
cadenas.Reposa en un área fresca y ventilada, hi: Rest in a cool, ventilated area, hydrate with water, remove one clothing layer if safe, and repeat the temperature reading.
cadenas.Resguárdate de corrientes frías, añade u: Move out of cold drafts, add a thermal layer while resting, and repeat the measurement to confirm recovery.
cadenas.Ajusta confort térmico e hidratación en: Adjust thermal comfort and hydration calmly, and repeat the measurement after a few minutes.
cadenas.Reduce fatiga visual, descansa en un esp: Reduce visual strain, rest in a quiet softly lit area, ensure good airflow, and note any visual discomfort for the Crew Medical Officer.
cadenas.Si es posible, traslada tareas no urgent: If feasible, move non-urgent tasks to a more shielded area or water-wall rack, log exposure time, and continue monitoring.
cadenas.Cuida hidratación, descanso y nutrición: Maintain hydration, rest, and mission nutrition; repeat the capillary reading calmly to rule out 0G fluid shifts.
cadenas.Hidrátate de forma constante para compen: Hydrate consistently to offset microgravity fluid shifts, rest, and repeat the reading at rest.
cadenas.Prioriza descanso, sueño en rutina regul: Prioritize rest, regular sleep schedules, and personal/cabin surface hygiene; log mild symptoms and follow up.
cadenas.Evita impactos o esfuerzo extenuante inn: Avoid unnecessary impacts or strenuous exertion, maintain adequate rest and hydration, and repeat the discrete panel at follow-up.
cadenas.Descansa unos minutos en calma, hidrátat: Rest calmly for a few minutes, hydrate well, check 0G sensor or strip placement, and repeat the measurement; notify the Crew Medical Officer (CMO) if the trend persists.
